name: io.github.kevintsai1202/muse-image
title: Muse Image
description: Generate, edit and iteratively refine images with Meta Muse, returning file paths not base64.

environmentVariables.name: MUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Meta Model API key, created at https://dev.meta.ai under API keys

environmentVariables.name: MUSE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model ID to use by default

environmentVariables.name: MUSE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for saved images. Defaults to generated-images/ under whatever directory the client launched the server from
